_readme: Confidence-gate curve for veet_tof_bands.py (format v2). The gate threshold is looked up from each zone's own measured distance on a 10 mm grid (10-2000 mm, then one open-ended bin >= 2000 mm). At load, veet_tof_bands.py fits min_raw(d) = a * d^-k (least squares in log-log space) through 'anchors', evaluates it at each 10 mm bin's near edge, rounds up, and clips to [floor_min_raw, 255]. Anchors at exactly 0 or 255 are clipped by the byte encoding and are excluded from the fit. Edit the anchors (or the floor) after lab characterisation, then use 'Reload Confidence Thresholds' in VEET_TOF_Viewer.py / VEET_Data_Charting.py or call reload_confidence_thresholds(). Reporting-band geometry is NOT here. See VEET_TOF_INTEGRATION.md section 3.2. 'weak_unbacked_exclude_below_mm': a return that fails the curve with no Object 2 behind it is normally treated as a phantom over open space and recoded far; nearer than this distance it is excluded (ambiguous) instead, because a real but dim near surface also hides Object 2. 0 disables.
provenance: bench characterisation, pre-validation: 'Chosen Confidence from Test' column of 'confidencev threshold from 2 obj.xlsx' (TOF_Conf_Test + TOF_Conf_Test-2obj; paper/phone, 0/30 deg, with and without wall behind). Hand-picked 50-150 mm values (>255) omitted; the fit saturates at 255 there.
